description: Get messages from a chat channel. Returns JSON object with channel_id, messages array (id, username, created_at, message, edited, thread_id, in_reply_to_id), and meta.

direction.description: Pagination direction: 'past' for older messages, 'future' for newer

page_size.description: Number of messages to return (default: 50, max: 50)

target_date.description: ISO 8601 date string to query messages around

target_message_id.description: Message ID to query around or paginate from

name: discourse_get_chat_messages
title: Get Chat Messages
